title: Computer Engineering, Minor (College of Engineering)
notes: University Park (College of Engineering) -- distinct from the Behrend/Erie campus 'Computer Engineering, Minor (Behrend)' variant, which is not offered at University Park. 19cr bulletin total, computed at 27cr. Prescribed CMPEN 331/431/362 (9cr; 431 needs 331, satisfied within this same minor). Additional: CMPEN 270 (4cr) -- real hidden gap found by testing this minor against a non-CMPSC major (MATH): CMPEN 270 carries a real concurrent requirement (PHYS 212), and 362 needs 270, so both cascade-block for any major that doesn't already carry calc-based physics. PHYS 211 (4cr, no prereq) and PHYS 212 (4cr, needs MATH 140 + PHYS 211) added explicitly so the minor is self-sufficient regardless of which major it's paired with -- CMPSC/CMPEN-family majors already have both, so this widens rather than duplicates for them. Supporting: 'select 6cr of additional 400-level CMPEN courses' -- picked CMPEN 417 + CMPEN 472, both needing only CMPEN 331 (satisfied above), deliberately avoiding CMPEN 441 (needs CMPSC 360, not guaranteed outside a CS-adjacent major) to keep the whole minor major-agnostic.
